items.q: What does 歌手2024 actually score?
items.a: [[audience-vote-is-the-rubric]]. **1,000 votes** — 500 in the hall, 500 in the cloud. No head judge. Pick three of seven after the last song. Metric is **did it move you**.

items.q: Why does she keep saying apples and oranges?
items.a: A piano ballad and a Douyin-grain original share one ballot. That is not a bug. It is the rule.

sections.title: Hold the color, or spend it

items.q: Why does Faouzia get docked for a good piano set?
items.a: [[hold-the-signature-color]]. The famous **thick/agile** voice stays in the bag. They guess she is saving rounds. The vote still docks her.

items.q: What made them retract on Chanté Moore?
items.a: [[live-is-the-risk]]. Whistle, hair flying, body trusted. A live set is a **string of bets**. She hopes she is still there at **50**.

items.q: When does a clean live tape lose her?
items.a: She hears a little **live tuning** on a just-broadcast clip. Inverse of [[live-unassisted-as-compliment]]. She does not want to say it. She says it anyway.

items.q: If Chinese voters picked two Western singers, what failed?
items.a: [[taste-gap-not-skill-gap]]. Ears want that color. The local **training OS** is the hole. Not 'cannot sing.'

items.q: Why is 韩红 'defend honor' the wrong fight?
items.a: Sending **China's best** at someone who is **not America's best** is a category error. Popularity at the top is not technique.
